items.text: every tabbed panel names its page at the top (Capture, Batch, Scenes, Auto play, Mic, Mixer and the rest); the tabs stay at the foot as its menu
choices look like choices: Batch's options and the presets in the Sound panel are pills, the chosen one filled
Batch is a tab of the capture panel, beside Capture: go back and forth without closing anything
on a computer, resting the pointer on the capture button shows the shot in the shape you picked, with its size; a still flies up from it into the share sheet
a video stops by itself at its length, picked beside the modes in Capture: 15 s, 30 s, or 1 min on a computer or tablet
a video that runs until you stop it
while a video or a GIF records, a small window above the bar shows what is being recorded, in its shape, with the time on its lower edge; tap it to stop
the GIF mark is a G with its arrow, thinner
Batch wears the padlock instead of a pro pill
Performing, in Settings, is a Pro feature, open while the beta lasts
in Auto play's Changes, the small gear grows out of its corner and turns when the pointer is on it; on a phone, swipe left from a tile's lower right corner to open that gear's settings
the Founders Club sheet opens with a note from Dimitry and his portrait; what founders get follows it, and the button says Join the Founders Club, in the accent
on a big screen the panels above the bar grow with their contents, so Auto play shows everything without a scrollbar
